selection_data: validation only; clean 9966 boards and deterministic 512-board transformed subset
selection_rule: among baseline and fine-tune best/last, require clean validation square accuracy >=0.99 and full-board exact match >=0.95; maximize mean transformed-validation full-board exact-match
note: Repeated synthetic-asset validation does not establish camera generalization. Partial occlusion may require abstention rather than correct reconstruction.
